jsonld.name: BNB Landscaping
jsonld.description: Landscaping company based in Miami, FL: lawn care, palm and tree trimming, yard cleanouts and landscape renewal.

parrafo.es: Bennito y su equipo atienden corte de césped, poda de palmeras y árboles, limpieza de patios y renovación de jardines en Miami. Trabajo prolijo y atención directa, según cuentan sus propios clientes.
parrafo.en: Bennito and his crew handle lawn mowing, palm and tree trimming, yard cleanouts and landscape renewal around Miami. Clean, careful work and direct attention, straight from his own clients.

hero.imagen_alt: Crew member tending a freshly planted garden bed in front of a Miami home, BNB Landscaping

parrafo_1.es: BNB Landscaping es el negocio de Bennito en Miami. Corte de césped, poda de palmeras y árboles, limpieza de patios y renovación de jardines, siempre con el mismo equipo de confianza.
parrafo_1.en: BNB Landscaping is Bennito's business in Miami. Lawn mowing, palm and tree trimming, yard cleanouts and landscape renewal, always with the same crew you can trust.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: rapidez, trato honesto y limpieza al terminar. Una clienta contó que, tras podar un alto seto de buttonwood, el equipo movió los muebles del patio y los devolvió a su lugar antes de irse.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: fast, honest and tidy when the job is done. One client said that after trimming a tall buttonwood hedge, the crew moved her patio furniture and put it all back before leaving.

items.quote: Bennito and his crew are the best! I called him with no idea of what I wanted, and he came through like a true professional giving my landscaping back life! He went out of his way to ensure I was happy! Very professional and reliable service! 10 stars!

I hired them to trim a very tall buttonwood hedge. The owner came out, gave me a reasonable quote and was cutting the trees 3 days later. They did an excellent job. Cleaned up everything, moved furniture, put everything back in its place. I couldn't be happier. Highly recommend!

B&B landscaping was so professional and they did an amazing job! The price was just right and the workers were respectful and very helpful. They really did a good job cleaning out my yard. I was so pleased.
